meta.name: playwright-cli
meta.description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动浏览器自动执行网页操作与测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要频繁验证网页功能并模拟用户操作
copy.tagline_en: Drive browsers to run web page actions and tests automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify websites or simulate what users do in a browser

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以操控真实浏览器:打开网址、点击/输入、填表/上传、截图/导出 PDF,还能切换标签页、模拟手机、管理 Cookie、录制操作,并运行/调试 Playwright 测试。执行动作后,它会反馈当前页面的快照,方便继续操作。
howto.when: 当任务需要操作浏览器才能完成时接管,例如打开某个网址、在页面上点击/填写内容,或用 Playwright 测试网页时。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com,然后把页面截图给我看看。
say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器访问该网址并截图反馈。

say.text: 用手机模式打开 https://example.com,大致讲讲页面内容。
say.note: 以移动设备模式加载页面,并返回页面内容概览。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude can drive a real browser: open URLs, click/type, fill forms, upload files, screenshot/export PDF, switch tabs, emulate mobile, manage cookies, record actions, and run Playwright tests. Each step returns a page snapshot.
howto.when_en: It activates when the task requires working with a web browser: opening a URL, clicking/filling in a page, or testing a page with Playwright.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and send me a screenshot of the page.
say_en.note: Claude launches a browser, visits the URL, and captures a screenshot.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com with mobile mode and describe what is on the page.
say_en.note: Loads the page with mobile emulation and returns a readable overview.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com, fill username a@b.com and password 123456, then submit.
say_en.note: Claude fills in the form, submits, and reports the outcome.
